Message:
The other teachers claimed
that analyzing the seed
would take 100 years,

but in my hands,
it won’t take more than
one lunar cycle.

Through my analysis,
my deduction was
proven correct.

The seed housed
the power of the entity
described in the legend—
a being best called a demon.

To prove it, I’ll need to
make the seed bud.

But without proper precautions,
that will only risk bringing
the world to the verge of ruin
a second time...

Something interesting has finally
graced this utterly boring world...

Having it be destroyed
just like that would
ruin all my fun.

So, I’ll implant this seed into
a specially prepared embryo,
and wait...

Until the seed lays down roots,
and the body grows used
to its presence.

As an identifier,
I’ll call the embryo “Meria.”

Though that name
won’t be necessary for long...

And, as for what will happen
when their body
overflows with a power
able to destroy the world...
Why, it’s as clear as day,
is it not?
